title: Scalp Self-Massage
summary: The finger pads make small gentle circles over the scalp.
startingPosition: Sit comfortably and relax the shoulders.
instructions: Place the finger pads on the scalp.
Do not scratch with the nails.
warning: Stop self-massage with pain, numbness, weakness, dizziness, radiating sensations, or other unusual symptoms.
